flow.name: axn-term - real devin session restore
flow.description: Set AXN_TERM_DEVIN_SESSION to an available real session. Start axn-term, close it, and verify the exact session is restored.

step.description: Create temp state dir and do not install the fake devin binary
Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
Wait for the real devin session to start
Close axn-term so state is persisted

assert.description: The app closed and saved state

step.description: Reopen axn-term and verify the restored session

assert.description: The same real devin session is restored and only one window exists
The same real devin session is restored and only one window exists
